I wrote `component.html` in the folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked.

It follows DESIGN.md, including the v4 Screens rules. It uses your exact content and no JavaScript.

- **Layout:** the page is white, in a 1120px column inside the 1280px `#component`. The "Requests" heading and the New Request button share the top row.
- **Search and filters:** the search field has its label above it. The filters sit on the right. "All" is the selected one, with an outlined pill. "Open" and "Closed" are quiet buttons with no border.
- **Table:** it sits in a bordered card with a label-style header row, 52px rows and hairline dividers. Status values are pills, and the other columns are plain text.
- **Fonts:** Unbounded and Archivo aren't bundled, because the folder has no font files. The page uses the `tokens.css` fallbacks (system fonts), so the heading won't be in Unbounded Light.
- **Tokens:** I copied only the light-theme tokens the page uses into the file's own style block, so it stays self-contained.
